name: Hair by Kalyn
description: Hair by Kalyn is a blonde-loving stylist specialising in sun-kissed highlights, lived-in balayage, soft beachy waves, and healthy, glowing hair that looks effortless every day.

hero.title: Blonde, sun-kissed, effortless.
hero.subtitle: Bright blondes, lived-in balayage, and soft beachy waves by Kalyn — hair that feels like a permanent vacation. Book today.

stylists.name: Kalyn
stylists.title: Owner & Blonde Specialist
stylists.bio: Kalyn loves creating bright, sun-kissed blondes and soft beachy waves that look effortless every day. She focuses on healthy hair, lived-in color that grows out beautifully, and making every client feel like they just got back from vacation.

reviews.name: Madison T.
reviews.text: Kalyn gave me the perfect sun-kissed blonde. So bright but still natural, and my hair feels healthy!

reviews.name: Ava L.
reviews.text: She did my prom hair and the waves held all night. I got so many compliments!

reviews.name: Sydney R.
reviews.text: My balayage grew out so beautifully. Kalyn is sweet, talented, and really listens.

reviews.name: Lily M.
reviews.text: Best highlights I've ever had. I always leave feeling like I just got back from the beach.
